<!--
The PDF edition of the report: one native Quarto/Typst document carrying the
summary that index.qmd shows plus the full listing from details.qmd.

Quarto cannot render those two pages to PDF directly. They hand it raw HTML
through IPython.display.HTML(), and pandoc drops all but plain <table> markup
when it targets Typst, printing "<IPython.core.display.HTML object>" in place
of every result card. vip.report_typst renders the same content as Typst
markup instead — see that module's docstring, including why the fonts under
fonts/ are vendored.

There is no title in the front matter on purpose: Quarto's Typst template
centers a front-matter title, and the report's own left-aligned heading comes
from render_document, matching index.qmd.

The cell fence is four backticks so the three-backtick raw Typst block it
prints survives inside it.
-->

````{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

from pathlib import Path

from vip import report_typst
from vip.reporting import load_results, load_troubleshooting, troubleshooting_path

data = load_results(Path("results.json"))
_troubleshooting_path = troubleshooting_path()
hints = load_troubleshooting(_troubleshooting_path) if _troubleshooting_path else {}

print("```{=typst}")
print(report_typst.render_document(data, hints))
print("```")
````
